title: Concept statistics count human related_to links
description:
Every consumer that counts reference -> concept 'mentions' must also count current related_to reference -> semanticNode: the concept report, knowledge_snapshot (trends, entity pages), knowledge_wiki pages, ontology_enrichment.RELATION_WEIGHTS (give related_to-to-concept a weight; human links at least as strong as extracted mentions), and the S1.2 signal inputs. Find all readers with grep for '"mentions"' and the predicate constant.
Tests: a Reference linked to a concept only by a human related_to edge counts in the concept report and the acceptance signal.
Owner rules that apply: no fixed caps, day windows or magic thresholds (derive or learn them; bound only by time, cost, context size); decisions go to decision models (Jev / the site Cyclotron), the LLM (GPT-6 Luna) only writes; Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) for every behaviour change; say "idea(s)", never "draft"/"proposed story".
